instruction: Convert all the text in my document to uppercase and save the file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly downloads the saved docx file from the expected path after postconfig triggers Ctrl+S save.
Getter iterates all paragraphs and table cells to collect alphabetic characters, then strictly checks all(c.isupper()) — correctly verifies the uppercase-all-text requirement.
Metric returns 1.0 only when all_upper=True, providing no partial credit for incomplete conversion — appropriate for a binary 'all uppercase' requirement.
Expected is empty rules dict and metric ignores 'expected' parameter entirely — no parameter handling issue.
Negative control resistance is good: initial document has mixed/lowercase text so all_upper=False and score=0.0 for a do-nothing agent.
Postconfig (Ctrl+S + 2s sleep) correctly ensures the file is flushed to disk before the getter reads it.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor gap: getter only iterates doc.paragraphs and doc.tables, missing headers, footers, and text boxes. For a standard body-text document this is acceptable, but to be fully rigorous, also iterate doc.sections[i].header/footer paragraphs.
